From: Dana Whitlock <dwhitlock@brazosfreight.example> | 2026-11-09T08:12:00
Jordan,

During final review our team compared your completed security questionnaire against the trust page on your website. Question 14 on the questionnaire states Routewell holds a current SOC 2 Type II report. Your trust page states a Type I report was issued in April and a Type II audit is "in progress."

These are not the same thing, and our vendor policy requires Type II for any system touching driver PII. Until this is resolved I have asked our legal team to hold the order form. They would like a call this week with someone from your security team who can speak to the actual status and timeline.

Please let me know availability.

Dana Whitlock

Brazos Freight Partners

Priya
